Source_A: Text/XRD: annealed samples have a single FCC phase and no HCP peak
Decision: Preserve both; canonical numeric EBSD trace HCP=0.001 with explicit conflict status
Why: The two modalities/text descriptions are not exactly identical and 0.1% may reflect trace classification/noise.
Implementation_Rule: Never silently round A650 HCP to 0 or call 0.1% definitive bulk HCP without provenance.

Source_B: SAED shows twin diffraction, but deformation-twin origin at 15% is not explicitly established
Why: Twin presence alone is not equivalent to deformation TWIP if the twin is pre-existing/annealing in origin.
Implementation_Rule: Only promote A600 TWIP=1 at stages with direct deformation-twin evidence (30% and fracture).
